Container.Name: Wordly
Container.Overview: Self-hosted daily word games with shared leaderboards: Wordly (guess the 5 or 6 letter word), Spelly Bee (make words from seven letters), Boxy Letters (chain words around a square) and Connecty (sort sixteen words into four groups). Everyone on your server gets the same daily puzzles, plus practice mode, a timer, and 19 themes. Mobile-friendly, no accounts: players just pick a name. Map /data to appdata so leaderboards survive updates.
Container.DonateText: Enjoying Wordly? Buy me a coffee

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Leaderboard scores are stored here. Keep this mapped so they survive container updates.

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Set to 1 if Wordly sits behind a reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel, so rate limits use each player's real IP. Leave empty if players connect directly.

Config.Name: RATE_LIMIT_WRITES
Config.Description: Score submissions allowed per IP per minute.

Config.Name: RATE_LIMIT_READS
Config.Description: Leaderboard reads allowed per IP per minute.
